title: Hold a licence or registration to transport waste
what: Transport trackable (hazardous) waste above the schedule thresholds only under an environment protection licence from the EPA.

laws.title: Protection of the Environment Operations Act 1997 (NSW)

sources.title: Protection of the Environment Operations Act 1997 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person who carries on any such scheduled activity is guilty of an offence, unless the person is, at the time that activity is carried on, the holder of a licence that authorises that activity to be carried on
